# Urban Eco Solutions Pte Ltd

> Indoor 5-tier soil-free hydroponic grow systems for Singapore schools, offices, condos and homes. 5 layers: 4 planting layers of 18 (72 plants) + a seedling layer of 76, 20 crops trialled, 4-7 week cycles. Size 811 × 433 × 1,805 mm (L × W × H). Package from S$1,300 incl. delivery, installation, training and one servicing. WhatsApp 8699 6726.
